mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_exam (title, description, duration_minutes, total_score, pass_score, difficulty, question_count, status, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{durationMinutes}, #{totalScore}, #{passScore}, #{difficulty}, #{questionCount}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM quiz_exam WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quiz_exam WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
